source_sql:
SELECT hub.node_id,rk.node_id,rk.specRelease,rk.specVersion,
                    s.node_id,s.sectionNumber,s.sectionTitle,s.level
             FROM Spec hub JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id
             JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=ir.src_id
             LEFT JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=rk.node_id
             LEFT JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=bs.src_id AND s.level=1
             WHERE hub.specNumber=? AND hub.specRelease IS NULL
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CR cr JOIN rel_MODIFIES e ON e.src_id=cr.node_id WHERE e.dst_id=hub.node_id)
             ORDER BY rk.node_id,s.sectionNumber,s.node_id
